page_title: GEN 3-0 CAG | Genoa v Cagliari 29/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Federico Dionisi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Genoa take a short corner kick.

90+2' Vitinha (Genoa) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Simone Scuffet with a brilliant diving save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Genoa are going to take it.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Vitinha (Genoa) is penalised for a foul. Federico Dionisi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
86' Vitinha (Genoa) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

86' Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets too much on the ball and it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) will replace Tommaso Augello.
84' The current number of shots on goal is 4:1.
82' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Josep Martinez intercepts the ball.
80' Genoa keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
78' It will be a substitution. Vitinha (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Albert Gudmundsson walks off.
76' Some patient build-up play from Genoa as they look to unlock the defence.

74' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) looks furious with himself after spurning a great chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
73' Today's match ends for Johan Vasquez who will be replaced by Giorgio Cittadini (Genoa).
73' Here is a change. Milan Badelj is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Emil Bohinen (Genoa).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eldor Shomurodov departs the field of play to be replaced by Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).
72' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
70' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
70' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
69' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
69' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
68' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
67' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Now Cagliari have a corner.
66' Great teamplay by Cagliari as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
64' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Stefano Sabelli and he is replaced by Djed Spence (Genoa).
64' Substitution. Aaron Martin makes way for Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa).
63' 3 - 0 Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
62' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:7.
60' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) flies well wide of the right post.
60' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

60' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
58' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico Dionisi had an easy-decision to make.

57' Koni De Winter (Genoa) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
56' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
53' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Simone Scuffet is prepared and dives to thwart him.
50' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

48' Milan Badelj (Genoa) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
46' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a half-time substitution. Gabriele Zappa comes on in place of Pantelis Hatzidiakos (Cagliari).
46' The game is over for Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari). Gianluca Lapadula comes on for the second half.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) is replaced by Nahitan Nandez.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
45+1' Cagliari win a corner.
45+1' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
39' The Cagliari players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' The ball possession is 72:28.

35' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.

33' Good chance! Mateo Retegui (Genoa) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

31' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Josep Martinez pulls off an easy save.
30' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

27' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Johan Vasquez, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Morten Frendrup (Genoa), who beats Simone Scuffet with a brilliant shot into the top right corner. 2:0.

25' Aaron Martin (Genoa) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.

25' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico Dionisi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Genoa earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
23' Genoa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
21' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' The game is interrupted now, Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' 1 - 0 It's in! Morten Thorsby (Genoa) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the bottom right corner after a cheeky lofted pass from Stefano Sabelli. 1:0.

16' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
15' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but Simone Scuffet comfortably gathers the ball.
13' Koni De Winter (Genoa) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
12' Aaron Martin (Genoa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
12' Genoa are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Josep Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
6' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
5' The Genoa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
3' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Simone Scuffet, who smothers the ball.
1' Genoa are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Genoa will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Federico Dionisi.
